story: Shikha Gupta (Co-Founder & CEO) and Aditya Gupta (Co-Founder & CTO) founded Thridify in Delhi in 2022.
Today Shikha leads the company from the Greater Toronto Area, bringing 3D and AR commerce to North American retail.
Our Delhi team continues to power engineering, 3D production and operations.

mission.title: Make every product touchable, configurable and real — before purchase.
mission.body: We believe the next decade of commerce belongs to brands that let customers experience products with flagship-store depth. Thridify puts that within reach of any team — no code, no 3D specialists, no long timelines. Real-time 3D, app-free AR, AI-generated content and analytics, in one platform.
